R7BK-grouse-drive-0002.pressureWhy: Busier: within 1 km of a paved road (estimate).
R7BK-grouse-drive-0002.parkWhat: pull off on resource road (paved road)

evidence.t: 100% of the stretch in grouse forest zones (BWBS, CWH, ESSF, ICH, IDF, MS, SBPS, SBS).
2 cutblocks touch the road (30 years old or less): edges and clover.
11 wetlands, lakes or creeks along the road: riparian edges.
Black bear: young cutblocks and burns grow berries in late summer and fall (Tip).

plan: Drive: from Old Fort Nelson, about 80 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate). Via Kotcho Mainline, resource road.
Park: 59.27732, -121.93318, pull off on resource road (paved road). Map links below.
Walk or drive slowly: the resource road stretch, 5.3 km one way. About 107 min one way at 3 km/h.
Hunt: grouse, Sept, Oct, Nov (season rows). Walk slowly in the first and last 2 hours of light. Watch where cutblocks and creeks meet the road (Tip).
Use: .22 rimfire for a sitting grouse inside 25 m (27 yd), or a shotgun with lead 6 or 7.5 (Tip).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 7-56, Region 7B. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2026-08-05, closures 2026-10-16.
